dslRule:
<!id: replace-sharedastprovider-wait-policy>
<!description: Replace SharedASTProvider.WAIT_ACTIVE_ONLY with SharedASTProvider.WAIT_NO for AST retrieval. This avoids blocking the UI thread and improves responsiveness, but might lead to null ASTs more often.>
<!severity: HINT>
<!tags: performance, threading>

org.eclipse.jdt.ui.SharedASTProvider.WAIT_ACTIVE_ONLY
=> org.eclipse.jdt.ui.SharedASTProvider.WAIT_NO
;;
summary: Replaces SharedASTProvider.WAIT_ACTIVE_ONLY with SharedASTProvider.WAIT_NO to prevent blocking the UI thread during AST retrieval.
